recentItems.title: Robin Williams on the appeal of British comedy - BBC
recentItems.description:
Whilst promoting his latest film ‘Good Morning Vietnam’, actor Robin Williams talked about growing up with British comedy thanks to his father, and his appreciation of comedians like Morecambe and Wise.

Clip taken from Wogan, originally broadcast on BBC One, 16 September 1988.
